question: What is the other name of Newton's first law of motion?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Law of inertia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Law of inertia**__

 __
 
• It is the **other name of Newton's first law of motion**.
 
• It states that an object at rest remains at rest, and an object in motion remains in motion at a constant speed and in a straight line unless acted on by an unbalanced force.
 
• This tendency to resist changes in a state of motion is inertia.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Second law of motion- **The acceleration of an object depends on the mass of the object and the amount of force applied.
 
• Third law of motion-Whenever one object exerts a force on another object, the second object exerts an equal and opposite on the first.
 
• Newton’s laws together with Kepler’s Laws explained why planets move in elliptical orbits rather than in circles.
